expression: (http.host eq "img.bluesia.net" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/home-data" or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/list" or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/genre" or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/country" or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/categories" or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/countries" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/movie/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/recommendation/")))
description: Blueflare catalog API allowlist: cache read-only catalog responses for 5m edge / 60s browser
